facts.subject: The Writing's on the Wall
facts.statement: The official quest difficulty of The Writing's on the Wall is Intermediate.

facts.subject: The Writing's on the Wall
facts.statement: The Writing's on the Wall: The wiki lists no recommended combat level or skill levels; the recommended field is only inventory/teleport advice.

sources.title: The Writing's on the Wall
sources.quote:
|recommended = * Several empty inventory slots
* Stamina or energy potions

facts.subject: The Depths of Despair
facts.statement: The official quest difficulty of The Depths of Despair is Intermediate.

facts.subject: The Depths of Despair
facts.statement: The Depths of Despair: Recommended: Combat level 15.

facts.subject: Icthlarin's Little Helper
facts.statement: The official quest difficulty of Icthlarin's Little Helper is Intermediate.

facts.subject: Icthlarin's Little Helper
facts.statement: Icthlarin's Little Helper: Recommended: Combat level 50 and Agility 35.

sources.title: Icthlarin's Little Helper
sources.quote:
|recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|50|link=yes}}
* {{SCP|Agility|35}} [[Agility]] to jump over the pit in the pyramid

facts.caveat: Combat 50 and Agility 35 both confirmed; the Agility 35 line is scoped 'to jump over the pit in the pyramid (higher agility helps even more)', so it is a minimum comfortable level for that obstacle only.

facts.subject: A Tail of Two Cats
facts.statement: The official quest difficulty of A Tail of Two Cats is Intermediate.

facts.subject: A Tail of Two Cats
facts.statement: A Tail of Two Cats: The wiki lists no recommended combat level or skill levels; only travel and desert-supply advice (a fairy ring route mentions 62 Agility as a requirement of that route, not a quest recommendation).

sources.title: A Tail of Two Cats
sources.quote: |recommended = *Fast travel to Burthorpe ([[games necklace]] or [[Burthorpe Games Room]] [[minigame]] teleport)

facts.caveat: Confirmed no combat or skill recommendation in the |recommended field. The only Agility mention (62, fairy ring route needing partial Beneath Cursed Sands) is a requirement of an optional travel route, not a quest recommendation.

facts.subject: Underground Pass
facts.statement: The official quest difficulty of Underground Pass is Experienced.

facts.subject: Underground Pass
facts.statement: Underground Pass: Recommended: Combat 60, Agility 50+, Thieving 50 (shortcut), Prayer 43 (Protect from Melee); combat 79 stops Blessed spiders being aggressive.

sources.title: Underground Pass
sources.quote:
|recommended = * [[Plank]] (obtainable during quest)
* {{SCP|Combat|60|link=yes}}
* {{SCP|Agility|50+|link=yes}} to reduce the risk of failing obstacles.
* {{SCP|Thieving|50|link=yes}} for a helpful shortcut.

facts.caveat: All four stats confirmed in the |recommended field. Agility 50+ is a floor ('+' kept); Thieving 50 is for an optional shortcut; Prayer 43 is the alternative to armour for Protect from Melee. Combat 79 (stops Blessed spiders being aggressive) is a separate line and is not part of the stats value.

facts.subject: Troll Stronghold
facts.statement: The official quest difficulty of Troll Stronghold is Intermediate.

facts.subject: Troll Stronghold
facts.statement: Troll Stronghold: Recommended: Combat 50, Prayer 43, Thieving 30 (boostable), and Agility 47 (requirement line says 47 is recommended; 15 required).

sources.title: Troll Stronghold

facts.caveat: Combat 50, Prayer 43 and Thieving 30 are in the |recommended field. Agility 47 is NOT in that field: it comes from the |requirements line 'Agility 15 ... (47 is recommended)', so it is a recommendation stated in the requirements field. Thieving 30 is boostable.

decisions.reason: Values match the wikitext exactly; the four caveats note scope of a skill line (route-only, floor, or sourced from the requirements field).
alternatives_considered: caveat everything for single-source/main-game scope (rfi-03 precedent)

decisions.reason: Current revid of every page equals the researcher's cited revid on 2026-11-22.

limitations: Single source type (OSRS Wiki infobox) for every claim; no T1 Jagex source exists for quest difficulty/recommended stats.
Only the |difficulty and |recommended infobox fields (and the Troll Stronghold requirements line) were verified, not walkthrough prose.
